guidelines.sheet: 3x3 sticker sheet, 9 separate characters, equal cells, wide gaps between characters, no character touches its cell edge
guidelines.style: flat vector sticker illustration, bold clean shapes, vibrant colors, friendly proportions
guidelines.background: flat pure green (#00FF00) background, no shadows, no floor, no gradients
guidelines.consistency: same character design, proportions and colors in all 9 cells
guidelines.motion: each character moves in place, no interaction between cells, static camera, seamless loop

plan.sheet_prompt:
One illustration of 9 separate characters arranged in 3 rows of 3, evenly spaced across a single seamless background.
Subject: a small yellow school bus.
Style: glossy 3D render, smooth rounded shapes, shiny plastic-like material, soft studio lighting with bright reflections.
Outline: none. Draw every character directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Reading left to right, top to bottom, every character is a different moment: a wide range of emotions AND different states of action (standing, walking, running, jumping, sitting, lying down, leaning, reaching, spinning), so no two characters share a pose, a body position or a silhouette:
Character 1: yellow bus driving happily down the street
Character 2: yellow bus stopping suddenly to let out smoke
Character 3: yellow bus tilted sideways by strong wind
Character 4: yellow bus spinning in a tight circle fast
Character 5: yellow bus lying flat on the grass after crash
Character 6: yellow bus jumping over a giant puddle
Character 7: yellow bus reaching out to touch a passing cloud
Character 8: yellow bus shivering in heavy rain and snow
Character 9: yellow bus dancing on the dance floor at a parade
Make every expression big and readable at small size: exaggerated eyes, eyebrows, mouth and body language.
Consistency: the same character design, proportions and colours for all 9 characters.
Background: a single, seamless, solid pure blue (#0000FF) background covering the whole image in exactly one shade, with no tiled panels, no shading variations, no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise.
Spacing: every character is full body with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its own size), clearly separated from the others, none touching or crossing another.
plan.video_prompt:
Animate this illustration sheet as a 3-second clip. Every character performs its own big, highly expressive, cartoon-style animation in place, inside its own cell, showing a wide range of emotions:
1. the bus rolls forward with a cheerful bounce in its wheels
2. the bus jerks to a halt and puffs steam from its grill
3. the bus leans heavily to one side as gusts push it
4. the bus rotates rapidly on its axis creating a blur of yellow
5. the bus sits motionless on the ground with wheels askew
6. the bus leaps high into the air clearing water below
7. the bus extends its front bumper toward the sky
8. the bus shakes violently as cold water hits its metal body
9. the bus wobbles side to side performing rhythmic moves
Animation style: wide emotions, highly expressive faces and bodies, exaggerated squash and stretch, anticipation and follow-through, clear facial animation (eyes, eyebrows, mouth), secondary motion on ears, tails and props, each character on its own rhythm, lively and full of personality. Never a static pose and never only a gentle sway.
Keep every character inside its own slot of the 3x3 layout; nothing may touch or cross a slot edge, and characters never interact with one another.
Empty slots stay empty: do not add any character, object or effect to them.
Static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cuts. Keep the one flat pure blue (#0000FF) background exactly as it is, the same shade everywhere: no shadows, no gradient, no noise, no glow.
Keep each character's design, proportions and colours unchanged and do not add outlines or borders.
